commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Danel Sinani will be replaced by Ben Alexander Voll (St. Pauli).

90+6' Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
90+5' The attendance is 29526.

90+5' Great save! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Nikola Vasilj.
90+5' Stuttgart keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

88' 0 - 1 Goal! Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. Ermedin Demirovic assisted in the goal. 0:1.

60' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the right post. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Nikola Vasilj to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Stuttgart.

57' It’s a PENALTY to Stuttgart after the VAR review!

55' Stuttgart take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

25' Florian Exner blows for a foul after Eric Smith (St. Pauli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Stuttgart win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
24' Chance! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Nikola Vasilj is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
23' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.

21' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

20' A raking crossfield pass from David Nemeth (St. Pauli) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
